kpis.label: ARC token presale
kpis.note: Presale revenue recognized in Other revenue as the Arc network launched on Sep 16 — the reason Other revenue jumped 627%

oneTimers: $182M of Other revenue came from the ARC token presale — gross proceeds were $242M for 807.5 million tokens at $0.30 each, with the rest still deferred. It is launch-related revenue, not recurring subscription or transaction income.

Operating expenses include a $9M restructuring charge for a workforce reduction of about 5%, $8M of acquisition-related costs (mainly the pending Tazapay deal) and $43M of stock-based compensation — items Circle excludes from its non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA of $317M.
otherDetail: Other income of $20M, net: $19M of gains on digital assets held for investment and strategic investments plus $14M of interest on corporate cash, partly offset by a $14M fair-value loss on convertible debt, warrants, embedded derivatives and U.S. Treasury securities, plus $1M of foreign-currency gains.

segments.name: Reserve income
segments.note: Interest earned on the cash and U.S. Treasuries backing USDC (a dollar-tracking crypto token). It fell because the return rate on those reserves dropped to 3.5% (down 61 basis points), even though average USDC in circulation grew 8% to $73.3B.

segments.name: Other revenue
segments.note: Transaction, subscription and other revenue. Almost all of the jump is $182M recognized from the ARC token presale; subscription and services brought in $20M and transaction revenue $5M.

takeaways.text: Other revenue jumped to $207M because Circle recognized $182M from preselling ARC, the token for its new Arc blockchain, which launched on September 16. Without the presale, total revenue would have fallen versus a year ago.
takeaways.title: A token presale did the heavy lifting

takeaways.text: Reserve income — the interest on the cash backing USDC — fell 8% to $658M as the return rate dropped 61 basis points to 3.5%, outweighing 8% growth in average USDC in circulation to $73.3B.
takeaways.title: Lower rates are squeezing the core engine

takeaways.text: After paying distribution partners, Circle kept 52% of revenue (its RLDC margin), up from 39% a year ago, as distribution costs fell 8% to $412M. Operating income rose to $208M from $81M, and Adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP) rose 85% to $317M.
takeaways.title: Circle kept more of each dollar

verdict: Circle earned $226M on $865M of revenue because a one-time $182M ARC token presale more than made up for lower interest rates cutting the interest it earns on the cash backing USDC (a dollar-tracking crypto token).
